method: All 665 manifest obligations receive a bound or unbound decision. This is a partial evidence audit, not a release waiver.
Bindings are manual clause-to-handler assessments and require actual named passing fixture output. Selectors only identify one printed fixture name; they never mint passing IDs.

Shared parameterized handlers are accepted for mechanisms tested across representative inputs. Per-content side effects and branches are not inferred from registration, a suite total, an ID mention or an action merely succeeding.
Recipe reference-damage/install-value and all-ID action-path groups provide partial observations. Unlinked clauses stay unbound.
All 207 physical output obligations remain unbound pending a named materialization/copy/canonical resale/lifetime matrix. This does not assert those outputs are broken.
Owner-held base-haul deductions/composition remain unresolved. No composition defaults, game rules, eligible pools, runner code or gate logic are changed.
New executions of independent source files are author-operated linkage evidence. Historical independent reviews remain unchanged; an independent review of these linkage decisions is still required.

Controlled fixtures include explicit arena state, test-only callback payloads and terminal ammunition. They are evidence for the stated mechanisms, not normal balance, visual quality or human acceptance.

The independent bounded semantic sample reviewed twelve selected obligations and identified five insufficient links (SH043, SH070, MA102, UGS-116, UGS-142). Those five remain unbound; the original138 candidate is archived separately. Fixture logs, binaries and executed source hashes are unchanged.
